title: Seek machine construction
statement: For each natural number $k$, the seek machine is the $(k+2)$-work-tape deterministic Turing machine over the Boolean alphabet whose state is a pair consisting of an optional seek key and a phase indexed by that key. It is constructed from the seek component, starts in the state with no key and the observe control, and uses the seek reduction.
caveat: The construction depends on the meanings of the seek component, phase-host machine, and seek reduction, which are not defined in the supplied context.
